# Fictional trade screenshots

These four English-language PNGs are generated artwork, with invented broker and
symbol names. They contain no accounts, real trades or personal data.

| File | Case | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| equity-match.png | US equity long | 10 × (110 − 100) − 2.50 = 97.50 USD, matching the image |
| futures-mismatch.png | Futures short | 2 × (250 − 245) × 10 − 3 = 97 CNY; the image says 94 |
| forex-missing-zone.png | Forex position with a clock time and no timezone | Do not guess the timezone or save the row |
| crypto-open.png | Open crypto position | Entry only, no invented exit or P&L |
